description: This file contains utility functions and types for managing Docker containers, orchestrating services, and performing related operations within the Android Cuttlefish testing environment. It includes setup and cleanup routines, image loading, container management, log retrieval, and network/status checks, all centered around automating environment setup for end-to-end testing.

classes.name: TestContext
classes.description: Holds connection and container details for the test environment, including service URL, Docker image name, and container ID.

classes.name: DockerHelper
classes.description: Provides methods to manage Docker images and containers, including loading images, running, removing containers, executing commands inside containers, and retrieving network info.

classes.name: DockerExecExitCodeError
classes.description: Represents an error when executing a command inside a Docker container returns a non-zero exit code.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by loading Docker image, running container, and ensuring the service is up. Returns a populated TestContext.

methods.name: waitUntilServiceIsUp
methods.description: Polls the service URL until it responds with HTTP 200 or times out.

methods.name: NewDockerHelper
methods.description: Creates a new DockerHelper client instance.

methods.name: LoadImage
methods.description: Loads a Docker image from a tar file and returns its name.

methods.name: RemoveImage
methods.description: Removes a Docker image by name.

methods.name: RunContainer
methods.description: Creates and starts a Docker container with specified image, returning its ID.

methods.name: getIpAddr
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of a running container.

methods.name: PullLogs
methods.description: Fetches logs from a container and saves them to a file.

methods.name: RemoveContainer
methods.description: Removes a container by ID.

methods.name: RemoveHostTool
methods.description: Removes a file inside a container.

methods.name: StartADBServer
methods.description: Starts the ADB server inside the container.

methods.name: ConnectADB
methods.description: Connects to an ADB device serial inside the container.

methods.name: ExecADBShellCommand
methods.description: Executes an ADB shell command inside a container and returns a buffered reader for output.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes a command in a container, returning a buffered reader for stdout if successful.

methods.name: runExec
methods.description: Internal method that runs the exec command and waits for completion, returning output or errors.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of containers and images, and pulls logs.

methods.name: DownloadHostBugReport
methods.description: Generates a bug report zip from the host orchestrator service.

methods.name: UploadAndExtract
methods.description: Uploads a file to the host, extracts it, and waits for completion.

methods.name: verifyZipFile
methods.description: Verifies the contents of a zip file by attempting extraction of all entries.

methods.name: VerifyLogsEndpoint
methods.description: Checks that logs endpoints are accessible and return HTTP 200.

methods.name: CreateCVDFromUserArtifactsDir
methods.description: Creates a CVD instance configuration using a specific artifacts directory, via the host orchestrator API.
